title: Censai Package Cognitive Load
description: Optional, additive metadata field on CensaiHub package and agent listings. Declares setup burden, interaction complexity, and attention cost on a 3-level scale so users (especially ADHD-first) can filter listings by tractability.

cognitiveLoad.description: Self-declared cognitive load level. See docs/cognitive-load-field.md for the canonical definitions.

signals.description: Optional structured signal data that justifies the rating.

setupMinutes.description: Initial setup time in minutes (0-480 = up to 8 hours).

decisionsPerSession.description: Decision points the user encounters per typical session.

notificationVolume.description: Notification rate during active use, formatted as 'N/hr' (e.g. '2/hr').

modeSwitches.description: Number of distinct views/windows the user must move between.

rationale.description: One- or two-sentence explanation of why the package is rated at this level.

lastReviewed.description: ISO 8601 date when the rating was last reviewed by the author.
